translated_title: Twenty Foundations Moved from Philanthropy to Funding Opponents of Mexico's 4T
original_title: Veinte fundaciones pasaron de la filantropía al financiamiento a opositores a la 4T
author: Aníbal García Fernández
meta_description: Aníbal García Fernández tracks 20 business-linked foundations that gave 2.7 billion pesos in 2025. As USAID money dried up, part of it was redirected to think tanks and NGOs.
